results.references: - Alexander Tyurin. [Toward a Unified Theory of Gradient Descent under Generalized Smoothness](https://proceedings.mlr.press/v267/tyurin25a.html). 2025. Complexity: $O(1+\Delta\,\ell(2\varepsilon)/\varepsilon^2)=O(1+\Delta\,\ell(\varepsilon)/\varepsilon^2)$ exact gradient calls for gradient descent with the integral step size to return a queried point with $\|\nabla f(x)\|\le\varepsilon$, for $0\le\rho\le2$.

problem_class.label: nonconvex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained minimization permits nonconvex objectives on ℝᵈ. The public starting point x₀ and gap bound Δ ≥ 0 satisfy f(x₀) − inf f ≤ Δ.
problem_class.evidence: LongTails/Setups/EllSmoothNonconvex.lean: Point, spec.Instance, spec.publicInput, spec.valid, spec.admissible.

oracle.label: exact_gradient
oracle.details: Every query at x returns the full gradient ∇f(x) exactly, for every history and seed.

oracle.label: function_value
oracle.details: The same query returns the exact objective value f(x) alongside the gradient for a single oracle call.

distinctive_assumptions.label: generalized_smoothness
distinctive_assumptions.details: The gradient is differentiable everywhere and ‖D∇f(x)‖op ≤ ℓ(‖∇f(x)‖). The public function ℓ is nondecreasing on [0,∞) and positive on (0,∞). For the public exponent ρ ∈ [0,2], ℓ(v) ≤ ℓ(u)(v/u)^ρ whenever 0 < u ≤ v.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/EllSmoothNonconvex.lean: Params, Regular, spec.publicInput, spec.valid, spec.admissible.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: Queries, gradients, the starting point, and the output belong to real Euclidean space of public dimension d.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/EllSmoothNonconvex.lean: Params.d, Params.x0, Point, spec.Query, spec.Reply, spec.Output, spec.publicInput.

accuracy.label: gradient_norm
accuracy.details: The returned point X must be measurable and ‖∇f(X)‖ integrable. The criterion uses the first power of the Euclidean gradient norm.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: E[‖∇f(X)‖] ≤ ε for the public tolerance ε > 0, under the product law of the algorithm and oracle seeds.
accuracy.evidence: LongTails/Setups/EllSmoothNonconvex.lean: spec.publicInput, spec.valid, spec.successful. LongTails/Template.lean: OracleTemplate.Convergence.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The Hessian bound varies with the current gradient norm through a public function ℓ whose growth can be as fast as quadratic.
